message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian federal holidays in 2023 that create **long weekends** (i.e., the holiday falls on a Monday or Friday, giving you a three‑day break):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long Weekend? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| Family Day | Feb 20 | Monday | ✅ |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | ✅ |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | ✅ |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | ✅ |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | ✅ |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | ✅ |

**Notes**

- **New Year’s Day** (Jan 1, Sunday) and **Canada Day** (Jul 1, Saturday) already fall on weekends, so they don’t add an extra day.
- **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11, Wednesday) and **Boxing Day** (Dec 26, Tuesday) do not create long weekends under federal law.
- Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in British Columbia) that can also create long weekends, but those are provincial, not federal.

Feel free to plug this list into your holiday‑planning app!
